name: lv_obj_refresh_style

ownership.argument: Object is borrowed and mutated; selector/property are scalars. Receiver and its resource sources must survive all synchronous callbacks.

provenance.source: Exact .155 AP instruction/call-site inspection plus source-compiled Unicorn probes in Canopus-Module-Resource-Hook/tests/firmware_reload.py; see companion evidence for byte-window hashes.

notes: Body checks global style-refresh enable byte at 0x200bd1e8+40, masks selector part bits and queries property flags at 0x0c3a5808. It invokes invalidation, style events and sizing/layout helpers depending on those flags. Direct refresh of property 40 avoids depending on unchanged-pointer local-style-setter behavior. Native refresh instructions execute in the probe with GUI event/sizing leaves modeled; no GPU drain or physical display acceptance is established. UI-owner thread only, outside IRQ lock. Host emulation is not a physical device probe or an approval for general veneer generation.
